messages:
alex: Heads-up — emergency route shim deployed to prod to stop a burst of 500s for tenant-phi. Rolling a toggle that pins requests to hf/shunt for 15m. Telemetry: https://console.redwood/telemetry/alerts/321 :rotating_light:

mira: On it. Can we add a request header so we can trace origin through the entire gateway stack? Suggest X-Rescue: true. Also we should surface the TTL in the console so ops don't forget to unwind.

sam: Quick sanity: what exact toggle key did you set? Need to create an eval prompt to replay failing traces.

alex: toggle key `route.shim.tenant-phi.v1` set -> on. Command used: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/toggles -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"key":"route.shim.tenant-phi.v1","state":"on","ttl":900}'`

deploy-bot: Deploy note: toggle route.shim.tenant-phi.v1 = on (operator: alex). PID 4821.

kevin: Console UX note: the emergency toggle flow should force operator + TTL + reason. Right now TTL default is 1h — risky. Can we add a compact confirm modal and an audit hint?

mira: I'll add header injection in the shim layer: middleware will add `X-Rescue: tenant-phi` if toggle present. Push in 2m.

sam: Telemetry quick check: error-rate for tenant-phi dropped 82% within 60s of toggle, but 2% of routed requests now 503 from downstream worker-4. Suspect route mismatch on long-payloads.

alex: Good catch. Can we flip partial traffic back to main path for payloads > 128KB? If we do that, ensure we mark in traces.

mira: Patch pushed: added size-based guard in shim. Rules: if content-length > 131072 -> bypass shim. Config snippet:
```
route.shim.rules = [
  {"match": "content-length <= 131072", "action": "shunt"},
  {"match": "content-length > 131072", "action": "pass-through"}
]
```

sam: Re-running the failing traces with the guard — looks good so far. 503s reduced to <0.2%.

kevin: For rollout UX: create a console banner that shows active emergency toggles with operator and TTL and a one-click rollback. That would cut the cognitive load for oncall.

alex: Agreed. For now I set TTL to 15m and put a manual watchdog: if errors < 1% for 10m, we unwind automatically. If errors > 5% we roll back.

mira: Added X-Rescue header and updated traces. Also created a short dashboard tile: "Emergency Shim (tenant-phi)" -> latency / 5xx / traffic split.

sam: Note: we should file a postmortem for why the upstream route started failing. Ticket created: INT-4582.

alex: Rolling TTL down to 5m to test rapid rollback behavior, then we'll follow up with the UX work kevin suggested.

deploy-bot: Toggle route.shim.tenant-phi.v1 TTL updated -> 300s (operator: alex).

mira: Pushing small console patch to show TTL countdown on the toggle card (will be behind feature-flag).

sam: Observability check in progress — traces include X-Rescue now. Good.

alex: If anything regresses we rollback immediately. ping @kevin if you want me to hand control to platform team.

kevin: Please handover after this window. I'll pick lookback and follow up on a dedicated emergency-toggle modal prototype.

alex: Thanks all. Will post a short thread update in #incidents and create a quick runbook section for this exact pattern. :thumbsup:
